dedupe_keys.name: modelling an intersection with traffic signal countdown timer

description: Eduard published this intersection traffic model as part of a University of Augsburg geography project. It compares conventional traffic signals with signals that display a countdown timer. The model tracks average vehicle speeds before and after the signal and measures intersection throughput. Coverage is a simulated junction; the source does not identify a measured junction geometry, calibrated traffic-demand period or transferable validation dataset. The NetLogo release provides a model for agent-based comparison of signal controls and their effects on road traffic. Its stated outputs describe simulated behaviour and are not observed performance guarantees for a proposed signal installation. Release 1.0.0 is available free through the CoMSES code repository and lists NetLogo 6.1.1. The release licence is CC-BY-4.0. Source code and model data were not downloaded or executed. Related resources include the CoMSES computational model library.
